envelope.name: The DIN 4108 envelope/climate record — the document's scalar fields (category, climate, airtightness, moisture, irradiance, catalog/material id, …), each a one-per-document value with no positional addressing.

layers.name: The `layers` register — the repeating, positionally-addressed construction buildup (insert-layer, remove-layer, reorder-layers, change-layer-thickness, change-layer-lambda), each entry a `Din4108LayerDocument{thicknessM, lambdaWMk}`. A genuine array with insert/remove/reorder semantics, distinct from `envelope`'s scalar fields.
